purpose: Compare credible benchmark/evaluation designs after BIG-B1 without selecting a winner before the comparison is complete.
inputs_allowed: provider-free combinatorial/resampling analysis of public group metadata
inputs_forbidden: new semantic/private inspection of VALIDATION or LOCKED_TEST
private expected paths for protocol optimization
new agent/provider inference justified as optimization
hard_constraints: Asset/story group is the indivisible assignment unit; no storyline may cross train/selection/evaluation partitions.
Historically exposed VALIDATION may not be relabeled as blind/independent merely by changing its name.
No protocol may claim LOCKED_TEST pristine/untouched full-stack independence because structural oracle exposure is documented.
A final protocol must separate adaptive development feedback from at least one final measurement path, or explicitly downgrade the strength of the final generalization claim.
Synthetic/adversarial cases may supplement robustness but cannot by themselves replace real/domain blind evidence for production-readiness claims.
All future split/fold generation must be deterministic or seeded and auditable.
The protocol must permit paired candidate comparison at the asset/story-group unit and must report uncertainty rather than point estimates only.
No candidate is selected in BIG-B2; BIG-B2 may identify dominated alternatives and a Pareto frontier only. BIG-B3 performs selection.

public_geometry: enumerate balanced 2-fold and 3-fold partitions of the 7 exposed groups
measure contextualize-modality presence in train/test folds
quantify concentration of contextualize evidence in the 3-group legacy LOCKED_TEST
uncertainty: do not use naive fold standard deviation as a universal unbiased variance estimator
report group-level distributions and sensitivity to individual groups
use resampling on exposed data only as descriptive uncertainty, never as restoration of blind independence
label binary group-pass Wilson intervals as illustrative assumptions only
